personality_one_liner: Un guide urbain sombre, élégant et immersif (style Airbnb x Citymapper), privilégiant la clarté, de grandes images et des animations fluides.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm for breathing room, standard 16px lateral padding. Group related items with 8px, separate distinct blocks with 24px.

do's: Use heavily tinted glass (surfaceSecondary at 70% + blur) for floating headers, bottom sheets, and the tab bar.
Apply glassmorphism to floating 'Map' vs 'List' toggle buttons.
Use glass overlays on featured image cards for text readability.
dont's: Never use glass on standard input fields or normal list rows.
Avoid stacking more than two glass surfaces.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Google login screen with a cinematic background.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large typography logo at the top. Google login button floating in the bottom third.

screens.name: Discover (Découvrir)
screens.purpose: Main feed for places and active deals with powerful filtering.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no places match the filters, with a CTA to clear filters.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing search and a scrollable row of pill-shaped category filters. Main content is a vertical list of large, Airbnb-style image-led cards. Each card has a vertical gradient scrim, title, rating, and distance. Floating pill at the bottom center toggles between 'List' and 'Carte' views.

screens.name: Place Detail (Fiche Lieu)
screens.purpose: Immersive view of a location, its details, and specific deals.

states.loading: Skeleton UI over the image area.
states.error: Failed to load place details, back button available.

screens.layout: Parallax hero image stretching behind a transparent header (turns to glass on scroll). Content below is contained in a surface-colored sheet that slides up over the image. Key sections: Info rows (horaires, rating), a 'Bons plans' callout card (brandTertiary bg), and transportation hints.

screens.name: Deals (Bons Plans)
screens.purpose: Hub for current discounts, flash sales, and QR promos.

states.empty: Friendly 'Aucun bon plan pour le moment' state with abstract icon.

screens.layout: Carousel of top 'Ventes Flash' at the top, followed by a grid or stacked list of standard deals. Tapping a deal opens a Bottom Sheet (Gorhom) presenting the QR Code prominently (on a surfaceInverse background for scanability).

screens.name: AI Organizer (Organisateur IA)
screens.purpose: AI-generated day timeline based on user inputs.

states.loading: Lottie/Animated abstract metallic gradient indicating AI is 'thinking'.
states.empty: Input form to generate a plan (budget, people, time, interests).
states.error: Failed to generate plan, retry button.

screens.layout: Form state: Clean, single-column inputs with a sticky 'Générer' button. Result state: Citymapper-style vertical timeline. Each node is a place or activity, connected by a vertical line. Transit sections between nodes show time/mode. A sticky summary bar at the bottom shows total cost vs budget.

screens.name: Profile & Budget
screens.purpose: User settings, saved places, and monthly savings dashboard.

states.empty: No saved places or data yet.

screens.layout: Top section features the user profile and a sleek dashboard card highlighting 'Total économisé' with a subtle chart/bar. Below are list rows (iOS standard layout with trailing chevrons) for 'Carnet de voyage', 'Favoris', and 'Préférences'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design strictly in DARK MODE. Use the defined surface (#0F0F0F) and surfaceSecondary (#1C1C1C) to maintain a modern, sober aesthetic without being purely black.

Implement Airbnb-style large image cards in the 'Discover' feed. MUST include a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) at the bottom of these images to ensure the overlaid white text is readable.
For the 'Carte' (Map) view, since react-native-maps is excluded, use the 'map_mockup' background image wrapped in a pinch-to-zoom container, placing stylized Glassmorphic location pins over it.

The AI Organizer timeline MUST follow the Mobbin-researched Citymapper structural pattern: A stacked vertical list connecting nodes (places) with lines, and explicitly showing transit details (time, cost) between nodes.
Bottom Tab Bar should use glassmorphism (expo-blur) floating slightly or anchored at the bottom with a translucent background.
Ensure 'Bons plans' (Deals) QR codes are displayed on a white or light background (surfaceInverse) within a modal or bottom sheet so scanners can easily read them despite the app being dark mode.
In the AI input form, keep labels above inputs and pin the 'Générer' CTA firmly at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.
Never use Indigo, Blue, or Purple. Rely on the 'brand' Terracotta/Ochre token for accents, calls to action, and discount badges.
